title: Genie 4 is in Project Genie. The gate is an Ultra plan.
friendlyTitle: Genie 4 is in a Google app. You need the Ultra plan.
summary: On 18 November, DeepMind said Genie 4 is rolling out inside Project Genie to eligible Google AI Ultra subscribers. You can type a prompt while a world is running, including to change the scene, and the model adds native audio. Google AI Pro members can join a waitlist.
friendlySummary: On 18 November, DeepMind said Genie 4 is rolling out inside Project Genie to eligible Google AI Ultra subscribers. You can type a new prompt while a world is running, including to change the scene, and the model adds sound. People on the Pro plan can join a waitlist.
whyItMatters: Generated video and audio carry a SynthID watermark, DeepMind says, and inputs and outputs are screened. The same post lists limits that remain: camera lag, fine physical interaction, audio precision, and whether a scene stays put. A playable world is not a finished game, and it is not on the free plan.
friendlyWhyItMatters: DeepMind says the video and audio carry a SynthID watermark, and that inputs and outputs are checked.
